notes: You can now set your custom payoff order right on the Strategy tab - no more selecting Hybrid, then hunting for the list on the Dashboard. Reorder in either place; both stay in sync.

Fixed a serious bug: switching away from Hybrid (to peek at Snowball or Avalanche) silently erased your custom order and reset it to the order you added the debts in. Your custom order is now saved permanently.
Fixed: Hybrid reordering had no controls at all for Premium members, and dragging never worked on phones. Up/down buttons now work everywhere, on every device.
